ValidationRule.description: Requires Competitor/dealer Detail when Out of Target Detail is Competitor/dealer.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISPICKVAL(Status, "Unqualified"), ISPICKVAL(Unqualified_Reason__c, "Out of target"), ISPICKVAL(Out_of_target_detail__c, "Competitor/dealer"), ISBLANK(TEXT(Competitor_dealer_detail__c)) )
